name: [Blackhole] Killstreak Vision
desc:
Welcome to Killstreak Vision or KSV

This game is based on Slap Battles by Tencell and his developers.

🔴In this game, you slap players off the map using a variety of different gloves. The more kills you get, the more gloves you unlock.🔴
⚔️PvP fighting game⚔️
